_doc: Draft Spectrum Frontier lines (River rewrites). intro: printed by the script before the fight (2 lines, <= 30 chars each). defeat: shown inside the battle when the player wins (2 lines, <= 24 chars). win: shown inside the battle when the player loses (2 lines, <= 24 chars). Use \n for the line break.
intro:
Floor by floor, that is the
only way up. Shall we?

Seven floors, seven colours.
This one is mine.

I have waited on this landing
all day. Show me something.

Level 50 is the great leveller.
Let us see who is ready.

The stairs do not care how
strong you were yesterday.

Mind the steps. They remember
every trainer who slipped.

A new challenger! The ledger
was getting lonely.

Nothing personal. The tower
simply wants a battle.

I trained all week for this
very floor. Do your worst!

Colours fade, but a good
battle lasts. Ready?

You climb well. Let us see
how you fight.

No wagers, no weather, no
rush. Just a good match.

Your Pokémon look keen.
Mine are keener. Come on!

The old Trainer Tower timed
everything. I prefer wins.

Do you hear that humming?
It means a battle is due.

Step up! The next floor
can wait a minute.
defeat:
A fair loss.
I will train harder.

Splendid! Mind the next
floor, it bites.

I was ready, and still
it was not enough.

Beaten fair and square.
Go on up!

That was a good one.
The stairs are yours.

My team did its best.
Yours did better.

Ha! I hoped for exactly
this kind of fight.

You read me like a book.
Well played.

The humming stopped.
You win this one.

Down, but not out.
See you at the top!

I will remember that
combination. Go on.

Even the colours blur
when you fight like that.

Fine, fine. The way
is open.

I lost, and I enjoyed
every turn.
win:
The Shell wins.
Better luck next time.

The stairs go down faster
than they go up.

Not today. Take a breath
and come back.

That was close, though.
Try again.

Floors like this are
why we train.

The tower will wait
for you.

A good fight. Not a
winning one.

Rest your team. The
ledger can wait.

Better luck on the
next climb.

You were nearly there.
Climb again!

I got lucky. Honestly.
Come back soon.

The humming goes on.
So should you.

Hold your head up.
That was a real battle.

Not this time, friend.
Maybe the next.

Down you go. Mind
the landing!

A fine try. Your
Pokémon tried harder.

brain._doc: In-battle Brain lines (2 lines, <= 24 chars): defeat = shown when the player wins, win = when the player loses. Script lines (intro, seal) are printed by the scripts and wrap automatically.

Lance.defeat:
A bond like that is not
taught. Well done.
Lance.win:
Not yet. A Dragon Master
is patient. Return.
Lance.intro: To think you'd make it this far!{FB}As the Tower Master I'll fight with all I have. That is the default rule of Trainers!{FB}Let's get to know each other through Pokémon battle!
Lance.seal: Lance: A title could not have done that. A bond could.{FB}The Silver Seal is yours, with ten Battle Points.

Anabel.defeat:
So that is how it ends.
Thank you for showing me.
Anabel.win:
I saw it. I am sorry.
Climb again.
Anabel.intro: I saw this battle before it began, and I still do not know how it ends.{FB}Please. Show me.
Anabel.intro_after: The song is quiet now. I wondered whether you would come.{FB}I saw this battle before it began, and I still do not know how it ends. Shall we find out?
Anabel.seal: Anabel: The Gold Seal. I did not see that one coming.{FB}You have my thanks, and twenty Battle Points.
